topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I walked into my home this evening, expecting the usual quiet of the day winding down, and there they were—sitting by the window, a vibrant bunch of flowers in shades I hadn’t expected in my life. The petals seemed to whisper secrets, the stems proud and strong in their vase. I approached, fingers brushing lightly over the petals, wondering. No card, not a single clue. Who would send such a thoughtful gesture? And why today of all days? The room felt a bit smaller, a bit warmer, with these unexpected visitors. I breathed in their scent, a mix of garden earth and fresh blooms, and felt the day’s worries start to unravel.
